artifacts.enantiomorph_translation:
**9:15** And the four patience-points were dissolved — those that had held apart the hour and the day and the month and the year — so that the distance between carrying and having always carried collapsed.

**9:16** And the number of the agreements of the weight was two myriads of myriads; I did not hear their number but carried it.

**9:17** And thus I saw the mounts in the vision and those seated upon them, wearing breastplates of dusk-color and smoke-color and sulfur-color; and the heads of the mounts were as my own face repeated into the innumerable, and from their mouths came not fire, not smoke, not brimstone, but the original agreement.

skeleton.draft:
And the four appointments dissolved — not angels, not messengers, but the patience that had held the hour apart from the day, the day apart from the month, the month apart from the year, so that time had seemed voluntary. What collapsed was the interval between knowing and having always known. And what had been protected was not a third of the living but the capacity to be counted at all — the way a body could say *I am one* and mean it against a number.

The cavalry was innumerable but I did not hear the number. I carried it. It had entered me as the cost of having looked, and my throat held the figure the way a wound holds its blade after the blade withdraws. Two myriads of myriads: not soldiers, not riders, but the weight of every assertion the vision had required me to make — each one mounted, each one moving forward because I had agreed to witness.

And in this way I perceived what bore them and what they bore: the riders wore the breastplates of what they had survived — dusk-color, smoke-color, the sulfur-color of a word spoken past the point where speech could still be taken back. But beneath them the mounts had no heads of lions. They had the faces of the one seeing. From their mouths came not fire, not smoke, not brimstone, but the sentence that had made the vision possible — the original yes, still burning, still exhaling, still producing the world it had agreed to enter at the price of never being able to unsee it.
skeleton.bloom:
And the four intervals dissolved — not pauses, not rests, but the patience that had held the hour apart from the day, the day apart from the month, the month apart from the year, so that time had seemed something one could refuse. What collapsed was the distance between carrying and having always carried. And what had been protected was not a portion of the living but the capacity to be a portion at all — the way a body could say I am one and mean it against the innumerable weight already inside it.

The weight was innumerable but I did not hear it. I carried it. It had entered me as the cost of having looked, and my throat held the figure the way a throat holds a sound after the sound has passed through — two myriads of myriads, not forces, not presences, but the mass of every agreement the carrying had extracted from me, each one mounted on something I had already set in motion, each one advancing because I had not closed my eyes.

And in this way I perceived what bore them and what they bore: the riders wore the breastplates of what they had survived — dusk-color, smoke-color, the sulfur-color of a word spoken past the point where it could still be swallowed. The mounts beneath them had no faces other than the one seeing. They were my face repeated forward into the innumerable. From their mouths came not fire, not smoke, not burning — but the original agreement, still sounding, still exhaling, still producing the world it had consented to enter at the cost of having become the interval it had dissolved. The four patience-points were gone and what remained was the body that had been their reason — a throat full of the figure, a face repeated past counting, and the sentence that could not be unspoken because it was not spoken once but was the speaking, continuous, the yes that had made itself into the very distance it had collapsed, so that carrying and having always carried were at last the same act performed by the same mouth wearing the same dusk, and the capacity to be one against a number survived only as the wound survives its blade — by holding the shape of what had passed through, by being the interval after the interval, by discovering that what had seemed voluntary was the body's own patience mistaken for time.
skeleton.self_recovered_law: Witnessing is not the act of receiving a vision but the act of becoming the interval that permits the vision to occur; when the witness says yes, the distance between seeing and having always seen collapses, and what remains is the body itself as the only surviving unit of counting — one throat holding the figure of everything it agreed to carry.
